correctness.rationale: Folding the min(x,t) kernel of JJ* about x=1/2 yields even/odd Green diagonal blocks and rank-one coupling; the eigenvalue boundary equations reduce to cos(t)-a cos(at)=0, with a=1 limit cos(t)-t sin(t). Real-rootedness follows from differentiation of sin(t)-sin(at)=2cos((1+a)t/2)sin((1-a)t/2) in Laguerre-Pólya; no zero at 0 and root simplicity follows squaring the two simultaneous equations (exceptional +/-1 checked separately). Hadamard order-one factorization with D(0)=1 gives the Fredholm determinant, not just secular zeros. Comparing quadratic and quartic coefficients yields only {a,b}={0,-1} as a distinct isospectral pair. The finite-rank correction to two scalar Green blocks gives Weyl counting constant max(1,|a|)/π and Schatten thresholds. Independently discretized J and output reflection for 6 real parameters, checking Hilbert-Schmidt traces and products at two z each; inspected verify_reflection.py. Numerical tests cannot establish the asymptotic result alone.
